note: United Kingdom, read on GOV.UK on 2026-10-30. Global Talent (for leaders and potential leaders in arts and culture, among other fields, endorsed by a body or on a prestigious prize): £766 (on the endorsement route paid as £561 for the endorsement and £205 for the visa), a decision usually within 3 weeks outside the UK and 8 inside (the longer kept), up to 5 years at a time, extended without limit; settlement after 3 or 5 years 'depending on which field you work in and how you apply' (5 kept as the general case; the indefinite leave page says Global Talent can be 3, and the endorsing body's field decides). Skilled Worker: the standard fee 'ranges from £819 to £1,865'; £819 kept, the fee for up to 3 years from outside the UK off the immigration salary list (£1,618 for longer; £943 and £1,865 from inside the UK); a sponsor's certificate ties the work to the employer; up to 5 years before extending, settlement after 5. Both also pay the immigration health surcharge, usually £1,035 a year, which the form does not hold. Irish citizens need no permission to enter or remain (the Common Travel Area guidance). Indefinite leave to remain is settlement and the route to British citizenship (naturalisation after 5 years' residence, or 3 for a spouse of a British citizen); its fee isn't on the pages read and is left out. The EU Settlement Scheme is closed to new arrivals and not modelled.

sources.title: GOV.UK, Global Talent visa
sources.said: You can live and work in the UK for up to 5 years at a time. ... Each extension can last from 1 to 5 years - you choose how long you want the extension to be. ... after 3 or 5 years, depending on which field you work in and how you apply. ... 3 weeks, if you’re outside the UK ... 8 weeks, if you’re inside the UK ... It costs £766 to apply. ... £561 when you apply for the endorsement ... £205 when you apply for the visa itself

sources.title: GOV.UK, Skilled Worker visa
sources.said: Your visa can last for up to 5 years before you need to extend it. ... 3 weeks, if you’re outside the UK ... 8 weeks, if you’re inside the UK

sources.title: GOV.UK, Skilled Worker visa: how much it costs
sources.said: the standard fee ranges from £819 to £1,865 depending on your circumstances ... up to 3 years - £819 per person ... more than 3 years - £1,618 per person

sources.title: GOV.UK, Indefinite leave to remain if you have a work visa
sources.said: Indefinite leave to remain is how you settle in the UK. ... You can use it to apply for British citizenship. ... You must usually have lived and worked in the UK for 5 years. ... If you have an Innovator Founder or Global Talent visa, it can be 3 years.

sources.title: Home Office, Common Travel Area guidance
sources.said: British and Irish citizens can move freely and reside in either jurisdiction and enjoy associated rights and privileges, including the right to work ... You do not need permission to enter or remain in the UK, including a visa, any form of residence permit or employment permit.

sources.title: GOV.UK, Apply for citizenship if you have indefinite leave to remain
sources.said: You can usually apply for ILR after you’ve lived in the UK for 5 years. To apply for citizenship with ILR you must usually have lived in the UK for 12 months after getting it. ... To apply for British citizenship as an Irish citizen you must have lived in the UK for 5 years.
